Subject: Intro: Redwood Inference demo and VP attendance coordination

Hi Lucy —

Great to meet you over email. Thanks for the intro last week. We’d love to run a 45-minute demo focused on three things: a 10-minute business overview for leadership, a 25-minute technical walkthrough (latency/cost controls, routing, and private deployment options), and a 10-minute Q&A.

Quick question up front: I saw your note about VP attendance — is Sarah Collins planning to join the entire session or just the opening overview? That will help us shape the agenda and which engineers to bring.

Proposed slots (PT):
- Tue Oct 12, 10:00–10:45
- Wed Oct 13, 14:00–14:45
- Thu Oct 14, 09:00–09:45

If none of these work, tell me two windows that do and we’ll pivot. I’ve copied Marissa (solutions) and Ben (CS) to cover follow-ups and post-demo next steps.

Attachment: Redwood_Demo_Agenda_v2.pdf (one-page agenda)

Best,
Jonas Weber
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0142

From: lucy.barnes@heliosanalytics.com

Jonas —

Thanks, that looks good. Quick notes from our side: Sarah (VP of Data Platforms) would like to be on the call, but she prefers to join just for the first ~15 minutes for the executive overview and then hop off. She has a tight calendar that day. If possible please plan to deliver the business-level slides up front and call out trajectory/cost savings in the first 10 minutes.

Procurement looped in here — we may need a separate procurement touchpoint after the demo for contract scoping. Procurement suggestion: if you can surface any standard enterprise terms up front, that will speed things.

Of the slots you proposed, Wed Oct 13 14:00 PT is the best for us. Can you hold that? Also: please include something short on security/compliance — we’ll want a one-pager or checklist after the session.

Thanks,
Lucy Barnes
Head of Solutions 
Helios Analytics
lucy.barnes@heliosanalytics.com | +1 206-555-0199

Per your ask, we’ve adjusted the agenda so the first 12 minutes are an executive-level deck tailored to cost/latency impacts and a two-bullet summary of strategic fit for Helios. Technical walkthrough follows with a short demo of routing + caching optimizations.

I’m attaching the one-pager security checklist and the updated agenda. We’ll have Ben join the Q&A segment to address integration and onboarding timelines.

- Jonas Weber (AE) — host/intro
- Marissa Cole (Solutions Engineer) — exec + demo lead
- Ben Carter (Customer Success) — onboarding/ops Q&A
- Optional: David Kim (Infra) — deep-dive, if you want a separate session

Best,
